note: Small vowels combine with the preceding katakana as one sound unit: フ + small ァ = ファ (fa). ヴ is vu; ウ is u, not a separate modern “wu” character. ワ / ウィ / ウ / ウェ / ウォ give wa / wi / u / we / wo. Standard chi is チ, shi is シ, ji is ジ; use ティ / トゥ for ti / tu and ディ / ドゥ for di / du. ヴ sounds may be approximated with b sounds by some speakers. ヰ and ヱ are historical characters, not the normal modern spellings of wi / we.
